## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Mataram, Indonesia. It starts at Jalan Raya Tanjung, Sire, Sigar Penjalin, Lombok Utara.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Vibrantly colored birds, iguanas, pythons, and different kinds of monkeys are all waiting for you inside of Lombok Wildlife Park. If you've always wanted to see tropical species in their natural environment, this is the perfect place. You'll also find orangutans, young and old, and elephants ready to say hello.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.49. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 3 ratings and 1 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
